items.title: Toshiko Akiyoshi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999
items.q: Especially Lew, the supremo player, I think he’s one of the truly great players. He’s also very dedicated. I always say I can’t afford him if I wasn’t married to him.

ctx.x: Well he doesn’t feel like he’s a good leader, plus he said that there’s no piano parts.

No piano parts, because I think a big band is somewhat like chamber music. You know it’s that much, only about 16, 17 people. Now chamber music you don’t really need a piano, unless it’s written especially for piano, or to play that part in certain positions. I have a couple of tunes like that. But other than that you don’t need a piano. Especially Lew, the supremo player, I think he’s one of the truly great players. He’s also very dedicated. I always say I can’t afford him if I wasn’t married to him. I would…
He wouldn’t be in the band if I wasn’t married to him.

items.q: Since then, if I have something, you know, a quartet situation, I always asked him

ctx.x: …you know, a cross between that [mimics sound]. “Why that? Who could that be?” [mimics sound again]. So, make the story short, that was Lew, and that‟s the first time I met him, and then I said, “I want to cop him for my concert.” And he sorta agreed, but … there was, Thad [Jones] and Mel [Lewis]‟s band had a swing tour in California, and Lew was asked to go. I think it was, that time I think it was somebody else who couldn‟t go or something, because Lew wasn‟t really a member. So of course, naturally, three…

they asked me to come and play, and with a horn player. So that was the first time, actually this was the first time we played together, quartet. And … so, Jake, he was, Jake Hanna was living in New York at that time and he didn‟t have anything, so he said, “I think I‟m gonna come listen to you.” So he was coming with us, and Lew was with somebody else—you had to take a … you have to drive there, so on. So as I said, I didn‟t know him, I‟d just met him, so I was kind of a little cocky, and I said [chuckles], I…
